segmentation.text: Persons riding bicycles, electric bicycles or electric scooters
shall not ride more than two abreast
except on paths or parts of roadways set aside for the exclusive use of bicycles, electric bicycles and electric scooters.

elements.justification: Admitted aggregates of the three defined terms, each one ru.aggregate atom ('membership of a legal aggregate'), never expanded; they class the subject and the other riders the obligation counts. 'riding' is read through the device's motion (agency reading).
st.roadway, 'the part of a highway improved for vehicular traffic, excluding shoulder', the extent of DEF-NRS-484A-220; rel.occupies anchors the subject. As the index maps 'upon a roadway'.

Riding abreast is riding side by side in a row: rel.longitudinal_overlap, 'the bodies overlap along the subject's heading (side by side)', at or above zero; travelling the same way, rel.same_direction, 'headings aligned'; in one row, the body gap rel.surface_gap ('distance between the nearest points of two bodies') within the spacing of riders side by side. Riding is moving: not drv.motion.complete_halt ('The road user is at rest at the observation'). More than two abreast is the subject and two other riders of the s1 aggregates so placed. longitudinal_overlap is used as the projection it is, not as a contact or distance; surface_gap is the body gap itself.

'paths or parts of roadways set aside for the exclusive use of bicycles, electric bicycles and electric scooters' is st.bicycle_lane_or_path, 'lane or separate path reserved for bicycles and the devices a jurisdiction groups with them'; rel.occupies anchors the subject on it: the riding the words except is the subject's own riding, on such a facility. The three device words name the users the facility is reserved for, the kind's own contract, not road users the duty counts.

applicability: The subject is a member of the bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter aggregate, is moving (not drv.motion.complete_halt with p.halt_speed_tolerance), its footprint overlaps a roadway, and it overlaps no bicycle lane or path at the observation.
obligation: At the observation there are no two road users b and c, distinct from each other and from the subject, each a member of the bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter aggregate and moving (not drv.motion.complete_halt), such that for each of the three pairs among subject, b and c the bodies are side by side (rel.longitudinal_overlap at or above zero) with headings aligned (rel.same_direction, p.side_by_side_same_direction_cos), and at least two of the three pairs have a body gap (rel.surface_gap) at most p.abreast_gap_max.

narrowings.why: 'Persons riding' is read through the devices' controlled motion, whoever controls them.

Abreast is read as side by side, travelling the same way and in one row, the row being two of the three pairs within the riders' side-by-side spacing; riders side by side but lanes apart are not abreast.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: Three bicycles ride side by side at 6 m/s on a roadway outside any bicycle lane, headings aligned, body gaps of 0.5 m between neighbours.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: A bicycle rides alone on a roadway: no other rider is in the scene, and the duty is decided for the subject alone.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: Three bicycles ride side by side on a sidewalk, overlapping no roadway.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but the source does not observe the longitudinal overlap of bodies.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: Three bicycles ride side by side within a bicycle lane of the roadway (exception).

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: Two bicycles ride side by side on a roadway, body gap 0.5 m.

scenarios.name: branch_3
scenarios.narrative: Two bicycles ride side by side on a roadway; a third, level with them, rides two lanes away with body gaps of 7 m to each: not in their row.

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
param_proposals.source: sensor speed resolution of the acquisition standard

param_proposals.name: p.side_by_side_same_direction_cos
param_proposals.convention: cosine of the largest heading difference (about 25 degrees) at which two road users standing or moving side by side count as travelling the same way: the heading spread of vehicles queued in adjacent lanes
param_proposals.source: lane geometry and queue observation practice

param_proposals.name: p.abreast_gap_max
param_proposals.convention: the gap between the bodies of two riders side by side within which they ride abreast in one row: the handlebar-to-handlebar spacing of a group riding side by side plus the source's position error
param_proposals.source: group-riding practice and bicyclist operating space (AASHTO)
